04-28-1817 + 31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 7 more days → total 224 days.  
1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
From Apr 28: Apr has 30 days, so Apr 28 → Apr 30 is 2 days, leaving 222 days.  
May (31) → 191 left, Jun (30) → 161, Jul (31) → 130, Aug (31) → 99, Sep (30) → 69, Oct (31) → 38, Nov (30) → 8, Dec (31) → goes into Dec 8.  
So 224 days from Apr 28, 1817 = Dec 8, 1817.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-12-08
